validity.researcher_notes: gem.wiki returned 403 (Cloudflare) so I went straight to open-web primary sources; wiki_citations.json is empty for this row as expected for the whole scope. Two independent primary sources both corroborate that SNGPL operates high-pressure transmission gas pipeline infrastructure along the Sahiwal-Lahore corridor: (1) OGRA 'State of the Regulated Petroleum Industry 2017-18' (government regulator report, Table 2.16 'SNGPL's Capacity Utilization of Transmission System') lists a named network segment 'AV29 - Sahiwal - Lahore' whose available capacity rose from 700 to 950 MMCFD between June 2017 and June 2018, with a footnote '(*) Capacity of the segments increased after commissioning of new pipelines under LNG project' -- independent confirmation that a second/loop pipeline was commissioned on this exact corridor circa FY2017-18, consistent with a 'Pipeline-II' existing alongside 'Pipeline-I' (P4108). (2) SNGPL's own Annual Report 2022 (live PDF, Note 20.1.4 Musharaka Arrangements) groups several financed transmission-line assets under the heading 'Sahiwal Line' (incl. a named '24'' Dia 67.77 Km Sahiwal - Phool Nagar (1st Segment)' asset) and, separately, in its infrastructure-projects narrative, describes a '24" dia x 46.80 KM Transmission Line from Phoolnagar to Nabi Bakshwala (Ferozepur Road)' plus a '16" dia x 26.20 Km Transmission Line from Ferozepur Road to Barki (Phase-I)' completed 'for augmentation/bifurcation of gas network in Lahore city' -- both explicitly called 'Transmission Line', both explicitly SNGPL assets. So Fuel=Gas, PipelineType=transmission, and Owner1=Sui Northern Gas Pipelines Ltd (SNGPL) 100% are all corroborated by 2 independent sources (a government regulator and the operating company's own audited financials) that are not GEM-derived and do not trace to one wire story. Checked the roster for a duplicate: P4108 'Sahiwal-Lahore Gas Pipeline I' (Sahiwal->Punjab, 142.93 km, 18in) is the obvious sibling, but the roster's own convention (Sui-Multan Loopline I/II/III at P4090/P4091/P4097/P4098; Faisalabad-Shahdara I/II at P4135/P4136; Dandot-Gali Jagir-Wah I/II at P4161/P4162) treats parallel/loop lines on the same named corridor as legitimately separate physical assets, not duplicates -- so I am NOT flagging P4140 as a duplicate of P4108.

validity.recommendation: Human review of length/diameter and StartLocation against SNGPL's own as-built segment naming: check whether P4140's 76.67 km / uniform 16in actually corresponds to a single documented segment, or is a conflation of the shorter, mixed-diameter segments identified below. If it is the latter, correct LengthKnown/Diameter/DiameterUnits (or split into a mixed-diameter note) and consider whether StartLocation should read Phool Nagar rather than Sahiwal.
validity.researcher_notes: Existence and ownership/classification are corroborated (see the paired confirmed-caveat entry), but I could NOT independently corroborate the SPECIFIC recorded spec (LengthKnown=76.67 km, Diameter=16in uniform, StartLocation=Sahiwal / EndLocation=Lahore) against any single documented SNGPL segment -- and there is a real numeric red flag. P4108 'Sahiwal-Lahore Gas Pipeline I' (same nominal endpoints) is 142.93 km; P4140 'Pipeline-II' is only 76.67 km -- roughly HALF the length for a supposedly parallel line between the same two cities (Sahiwal to Lahore is itself ~130-140 km by road/pipe corridor, matching P4108, not P4140). Searching SNGPL's own Annual Report 2022 (Note 20.1.4 and the infrastructure-projects section, both read via pdftotext after downloading the live PDF -- gem.wiki/anonymous search engines were not usable this run, WebSearch budget was exhausted, and ogra.org.pk/duckduckgo/google/bing all blocked automated fetches, so I worked from SNGPL's and the Wayback-hosted OGRA PDF directly) turned up two candidate real segments in the right length range but NEITHER matches P4140 cleanly: (a) 'Sahiwal - Phool Nagar (1st Segment)', 24in dia, 67.77 km (differs from P4140 by ~9 km AND by diameter, 24in vs 16in); (b) the FY2021-22-completed pair '24in dia x 46.80 km Phoolnagar to Nabi Bakshwala (Ferozepur Road)' + '16in dia x 26.20 km Ferozepur Road to Barki (Phase-I)', which sum to 73.0 km (within ~5% of P4140's 76.67 km) but are explicitly a Lahore-CITY network augmentation/bifurcation project starting at Phool Nagar (a town roughly 35-45 km from Lahore), not a long-haul Sahiwal-origin trunk line, and are two different diameters (24in + 16in), not a single uniform 16in run. Phool Nagar sits geographically between Sahiwal and Lahore on this corridor, so it is plausible GEM's 'Sahiwal-Lahore Gas Pipeline-II' is actually this Phoolnagar-ward segment mislabeled with Sahiwal as the nominal corridor start (the roster itself sets precedent for looplines starting at an intermediate point while keeping the corridor's full name, e.g. P4097/P4098 'Sui-Multan Gas Loopline II/III' both actually list StartLocation=Bhong, not Sui) -- but here GEM lists StartLocation=Sahiwal for P4140, not Phool Nagar, which is the opposite of that established pattern and is itself suspicious. I do not have a source naming '76.67 km' or a uniform '16in Sahiwal-Lahore' pipe verbatim, so per the corroboration standard (a source must AGREE with the GEM number, not merely mention the pipeline) this is a material, unresolved disagreement -- flagging spec/attribution rather than silently passing it. Did not find any evidence the row is fabricated (existence of transmission pipe on this corridor, and of a distinct 'II'-generation pipeline, is well supported) so this is a spec/attribution concern, not an existence concern.

summary: P4140 (Sahiwal-Lahore Gas Pipeline-II): existence/owner/classification confirmed high-tier via 2 independent primary sources (OGRA 2017-18 regulator report + SNGPL AR2022), but flagged SPEC/ATTRIBUTION concern (medium tier) -- recorded 76.67km/uniform 16in does not cleanly match any single SNGPL-documented segment on this corridor (candidates found: Sahiwal-Phool Nagar 1st Segment 67.77km/24in, or Phoolnagar-Ferozepur Rd-Barki 46.80km@24in+26.20km@16in=73.0km, a Lahore-city augmentation project) and is suspiciously half the length of sibling P4108 (Pipeline-I, 142.93km) for supposedly the same endpoints. Capacity left UNRESOLVED/blank -- deliberately not filled (only corridor-level, multi-pipe MMCFD figures found, not attributable to this segment alone).
